measureTop.line: Editor open. Keys W A S D move the view, key E up, key Q down. Drag with the left mouse button on empty space to circle round, with Shift to slide; the wheel goes towards the cursor; hold the right button to look around. Click a gate: the arrows move it, the rings turn it, the boxes size it; key F or a double click brings the view to it, key Home shows the whole course. Space or your controller's arm switch flies the course (hold Space to climb); a short Space or the switch again goes back to editing. Key Esc leaves
